name: Jeannie Tirado
bio: Jeannie Tirado was born on July 19, 1990 in Orlando, Florida, USA as Jeannie Diane Tirado. She is known for her work on Soul (2020), Doom Eternal (2020) and Orange (2016). She has been married to John Riding since October 24, 2021.

credits.title: Daffy Season
credits.overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

credits.title: Justice League x RWBY: Super Heroes & Huntsmen, Part Two
credits.overview: On the heels of successfully escaping a deadly digital trap, the members of the Justice League emerge in their own world to discover that Grimm, ravenous creatures from Remnant, have overtaken Earth! In order to defeat the monsters, they must call on their new friends – Team RWBY – for help!

credits.title: You've Got This
credits.overview: An ad creative and a successful exec have a great marriage — until he wants to be a dad just as her star is rising. Then he brings someone new home.

credits.title: Marvel Rising: Playing with Fire
credits.overview: Inferno’s powers are stolen by a young and powerful villain and it’s up to the Secret Warriors to defeat their new foe and help their friend. But does Inferno even WANT his powers back? Meanwhile, America Chavez learns a lesson about friendship and family from teammate Ms. Marvel.

credits.title: Receptivity
credits.overview: Receptivity follows the life of self-absorbed, pinched-off Julian as he rethinks old patterns of thought and begins to live the life he really wants.

credits.title: The Adventures of Petey and Friends
credits.overview: Desert Sky Air Force Base is instructed to carry out an urgent mission. Petey, a new fighter plane, arrives by forced landing. Petey is determined to carry out the most important task by himself and rescue his best friend.
